# Bug Summary — SauceDemo QA Portfolio

## Purpose

This document summarizes the defects identified during manual QA testing of the SauceDemo public demo application.

The defects are documented as GitHub Issues and connected to the manual test cases and requirements traceability matrix.

---

## Defect Summary

| Bug ID  | GitHub Issue | Title                                          | Account        | Related Test Case | Severity | Status |
| ------- | -----------: | ---------------------------------------------- | -------------- | ----------------- | -------- | ------ |
| BUG-001 |     Issue #1 | Product images display incorrectly             | `problem_user` | TC-007            | Medium   | Open   |
| BUG-002 |     Issue #2 | Product prices display incorrectly             | `visual_user`  | TC-008            | High     | Open   |
| BUG-003 |     Issue #3 | Checkout Last Name field does not accept input | `problem_user` | TC-009            | High     | Open   |

---

## Severity Definitions

| Severity | Meaning                                                                                                                   |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| High     | Blocks or seriously disrupts a core user flow, creates business risk, or could affect purchase decisions                  |
| Medium   | Creates user confusion, reduces trust, or affects the quality of the user experience without fully blocking the core flow |
| Low      | Minor visual, wording, or usability issue with limited user impact                                                        |

---

## QA Notes

* BUG-001 affects product image accuracy for the `problem_user` account.
* BUG-002 affects pricing accuracy for the `visual_user` account.
* BUG-003 affects checkout form input behavior for the `problem_user` account.
* The highest-risk defects are BUG-002 and BUG-003 because they affect pricing trust and checkout completion.
